A friendly update about rest breaks
It is for busy families
Travel notice for pet rest breaks

Travelers should know that animals in our care get planned rest breaks so the journey stays calm and safe. If you are getting ready to fly with a pet, please share any health notes early and keep the travel papers close at hand.

For reptile travel, <<FACT F078>>. Our team will look over the details with care and make sure the next steps are clear before departure. For bird travel, <<FACT F083>>. That way, we can help avoid delays and keep everything moving smoothly for you and your companion.

If you are traveling with Ellie or another pet, please pack food, water, and comfort items in a simple way that is easy to check. We appreciate prompt, respectful updates if plans change, and we will answer with calm guidance. Safety comes first on every trip, and the Companion Animal Travel Desk is here to help you through each step.

Please stop by the Companion Animal Travel Desk for friendly support before you go.
